articles.description: Newly elected Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) leader Kim Min-seok faces an early test of his leadership after three figures aligned with his main rival, Jung Chung-rae, won seats on the party’s five-member Supreme Council. articles.title: Rare crested ibis spotted in Gwangneung Forest northeast of Seoul
articles.description: In an encouraging milestone for Korea’s long-term wildlife restoration efforts, a crested ibis was observed resting among the ancient canopy of the Korea National Arboretum, marking the first time the endangered bird has been sighted in the historic Gwangneung Forest in Pocheon, northeast of Seoul.
